name: @gjsify/sherpa-native-linux-x64
description: linux-x64 prebuilt native library + GObject-Introspection typelib for @gjsify/sherpa-native. Installed automatically on linux/x64 as an optionalDependency of that package (ADR 0017) and skipped everywhere else. Contains no JavaScript.

platformsUncommitted.linux-x64: prebuilds.yml's `sherpa-native-prebuild` job builds it, runs the package's meson tests against it and uploads the staged dir on every change to the package, so the declaration has a job behind it; no job commits it back into this repo, because the staged directory is 29.9 MiB — 4.1 MiB of stripped bridge plus the 25.8 MiB `libonnxruntime.so` it must ship beside it, against 12.8 MB for the largest prebuild this repository does commit — and a sherpa-onnx bump would re-commit all of it. There is NO release.yml leg yet, so nothing stages this artifact into a published tarball and no consumer receives it: that is why the name sits in status/pending-npm-bootstrap.json, and it must not be bootstrapped until either a release leg stages the prebuild or the artifact is committed here (ADR 0127 step 2)
